scoped_check.claim: Every reduced DM3 witness whose ops or DM3 coordinate no pre-existing grammar can express is rejected by ALL pre-existing grammars: the 7 delay grammars all reject it with the SAME reason (UNKNOWN_OP:<opkind>: the DM3 op vocabulary does not exist in any delay grammar) and the point-set V2 grammar rejects it for its own structural reason (VALUE_OUT_OF_DECLARED_RANGE: the DM3 coordinate is not a declared face, or PARSE_REJECT: the supply/between ops have no face-typed argument)
scoped_check.method: machine_overview.search.within_grammar_witness (L1 predicate, values erased to their delay axis) for the delay grammars; machine_overview.v2_chain.within_grammar_witness (point-set predicate) for the V2 point-set grammar, which cannot parse DM3 ops or represent the DM3 algebra (see no_point_set_embedding)

per_family_reason_uniqueness.claim: within each grammar family every scoped witness is rejected by exactly one uniform reason
per_family_reason_uniqueness.delay_family: 72 + 216 + 104 = 392/392 scoped witnesses carry exactly one of UNKNOWN_OP:between / UNKNOWN_OP:supply / UNKNOWN_OP:tower
per_family_reason_uniqueness.point_set_family: 312 + 80 = 392/392 scoped witnesses carry exactly one of VALUE_OUT_OF_DECLARED_RANGE:left / VALUE_OUT_OF_DECLARED_RANGE:right
per_family_reason_uniqueness.cross_family: reasons differ between families (structurally different rejection: unparseable ops vs unrepresentable DM3 coordinate); hence scoped_all_reasons_unique=false and scoped_reasons_unique=0, which is expected and stronger, not weaker

scoped_check.ingress_disclosure: witnesses accepted by the point-set V2 grammar via the shared tower mechanism (dm3 coordinate = 0 lies in the point-set declared faces, tower level in its declared levels); the level_observation mechanism is shared with the point-set fragment and these witnesses are L1-invisible but point-set-reproducible.  They are reported as ingress, not as out-of-envelope.  All density and availability witnesses are scoped: their ops (supply/between over DM3) cannot be parsed by the point-set grammar and their DM3 coordinates cannot be represented (see non_embedding_check)

full_check.claim: Every reduced DM3 witness lies outside every pre-existing delay grammar and outside the point-set V2 grammar, with rejection reasons recorded per grammar

non_embedding_check.claim: NO meet-and-negation-preserving embedding of DM3 into the point-set boolean face lattice exists

domain.faces: 16 truth functions over the 4-point boolean cube (point-set mirror)

non_embedding_check.scope: the two declared finite structures only; NOT a claim about the real interval I (F-011 / 015 sec 5)

scope_boundary.symbolic_horn_grammars: 12 grammars of backend symbolic-horn-v1 are structurally unable to express any delay/V2 witness (missing delay_index_max etc.); schema-level BACKEND_MISMATCH, not mechanically checked in this unit; this is a scope boundary, not a proven disjointness (gap B of 修订片 018, unchanged)

registered_gap: Atria的方案/修订片/018 §3(A): the interval-I oracle does not exist (the point-set mirror carries the boolean law x&&~x=0 for free, while I is a De Morgan algebra in which it fails; the mirror proves in §10 via DM3 that the point-set model is not complete).  This grammar closes the DESIGN gap by re-interpreting the three structural V2 axes on DM3, the standard non-boolean De Morgan algebra, so the separations can be confirmed by the native kernel in an algebra where the boolean law FAILS.
scope_disclosure: ORACLE SCOPE (015 §5 / F-011 / 017 §5, upgraded by this unit): the oracle of this grammar is the Cubical Agda 2.8.0 native kernel on formal/V2DM3.agda.  DM3 is a NON-BOOLEAN De Morgan algebra, not the real cubical interval I (whose equality is not decidable, so no Bool-valued separates can be written on it).  The confirmed content is the NEGATIVE statement that no boolean law is needed (boolLawIndependence, kernel-accepted): the three structural separations are produced in an algebra where x&&~x=x!=0.  Scope identifier: DM3_DE_MORGAN_CONFIRMED_NON_BOOLEAN_LIFT; interval_i_confirmed = false.  Lifting DM3 to all De Morgan algebras or to I is NOT claimed.  registers_new_claim: false except the negative mechanical fact that the boolean law is not needed, which the kernel checks on this specific algebra.
